card.name: Linking words before metastatic cancer terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with" or "of" after patients or treatment, and a closing bracket after dMMR, in oncology dosing tables. They come right before a cancer type, often one that is metastatic.

modes.label: With/of before cancer type
modes.description: The word "with" or "of" after a patient group or treatment type, just before a named cancer indication.
modes.example: Adjuvant treatment<< of>> resected esophageal or gastro

modes.label: After biomarker bracket
modes.description: A closing parenthesis after a biomarker such as dMMR, before metastatic colorectal cancer.
modes.example: Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) or mismatch repair deficient (dMMR<<)>> metastatic colorectal cancer that has progressed

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward "met" as the start of "metastatic".
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a cancer type is named, where "metastatic" often comes next.
